arguments.name: relationshipCode
arguments.description:
When the user provides a relationship code, this is used for an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = REL_ID and returns the matching grid record(s). (e.g., "000008").

raw.name: relationshipCode
raw.description:
When the user provides a relationship code, this is used for an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = REL_ID and returns the matching grid record(s). (e.g., "000008").

arguments.name: relationshipName
arguments.description:
When the user provides a relationship name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = REL_NAME and returns all matching grid rows. (e.g., "Brother", "Sister", "Spouse").

raw.name: relationshipName
raw.description:
When the user provides a relationship name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = REL_NAME and returns all matching grid rows. (e.g., "Brother", "Sister", "Spouse").

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing relationships, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All and returns every grid row.

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Page size value sent to the grid pager (server may cap it). Default "100".

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety cap to avoid infinite paging loops. Default "50".
